stem: Which statement best explains why the sun appears to move across the sky during the day?

options.label: F
options.text: The Earth is closest to the sun in the winter.

options.label: G
options.text: The Earth is revolving around the sun.

options.label: H
options.text: The Earth is tilted at 23.5 degrees.

options.label: J
options.text: The Earth is rotating on its axis.
